title: TRACE Bench: Task-driven Roleplay Agentic Checklist Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.11236v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Roleplay evaluation should do more than assign a single score: it should reveal which role requirements were tested, which failed, and which dialogue evidence supports the judgment. We propose TRACE Bench, a task-driven agentic checklist evaluation framework. It decomposes each role profile offline into a fixed checklist, then uses a User Agent to converse naturally with the target roleplay model while privately updating checklist states from model responses. Scores therefore trace back to checklist items and supporting dialogue turns rather than a black-box holistic impression. For coverage cross-validation, we audit released M2 free-dialogue transcripts from the MiniMax Role-play Benchmark against the same role-derived checklist. The released free-chat transcripts cover only 73.74% of key role-profile points, whereas TRACE Bench reaches 99.91% coverage in fewer turns. translated_title: TRACE Bench：任务驱动的角色扮演智能体检查表评估
translated_abstract: 角色扮演评估不应仅仅给出一个分数，而应揭示哪些角色要求被测试、哪些未通过，以及哪些对话证据支持该判断。我们提出了TRACE Bench，一个任务驱动的智能体检查表评估框架。它离线将每个角色档案分解为一个固定的检查表，然后使用用户智能体与目标角色扮演模型自然对话，同时私下根据模型响应更新检查表状态。因此，分数可追溯到检查表项目和支撑性对话轮次，而非黑箱式的整体印象。为了覆盖交叉验证，我们使用相同的角色派生检查表，对MiniMax角色扮演基准发布的M2自由对话转录进行了审计。发布的自由聊天转录仅覆盖了关键角色档案要点的73.74%，而TRACE Bench在更少的轮次内达到了99.91%的覆盖率。鲁棒性实验表明，在重复运行下排名稳定。
tldr: TRACE Bench通过任务驱动的检查表框架，将角色扮演评估从黑箱打分转变为可追溯的逐项验证，并在更少轮次内实现了99.91%的关键角色覆盖，显著优于现有基准。
en_tdlr: TRACE Bench transforms roleplay evaluation from black-box scoring into traceable checklist-based verification, achieving 99.91% key-role coverage in fewer turns, significantly outperforming existing benchmarks.
